Bridging the Gap

My TEDx talk was about why General Relativity and Quantum Mechanics don’t get along, and a few of the ideas trying to fix that. This is the talk as an essay.

The problem

One paragraph: our two best theories disagree, and where that matters. 800 to 1,000 words in total, from your script, at the level of the talk: engaging, not technical.
